name: The Lonely Tree
detailed_description:
Diary of Your Life and Others

Create a personal collection of important life events, writing them as diary entries that shape your journey.

As you add each entry, it becomes a node on your tree, growing and branching as your tree expands and connect with the stories of others.

Connect with Strangers with Similar Experiences

As you build your tree of life, you'll discover that your entries resonate with others.

When your entry aligns with someone else's, their story intertwines with yours, creating new connections and shared experiences.

You’ll grow alongside anonymous players, bound together by similar milestones and emotions.

Build and Customize your Tree

Your tree reflects your life, shaped by the entries you add.

As you grow, watch your tree flourish—an expanding symbol of your personal journey. But with growth comes the need to prune branches, allowing new ones to emerge.

With the changing seasons, your tree transforms, adapting to its environment and to your journey.

Grow your environment 

Start as a tiny sapling on a hill beside a tranquil lake. As you continue to add entries and grow, your environment evolves in tandem with you.

In time, your tree will stand tall in a vast meadow, hosting a vibrant community of plants and animals.

Though still the same solitary tree on a quiet island, it now thrives, intertwined with the stories of others and becoming a home to all who may find solace in your branches.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: x64 architecture
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 4000 (AMD or NVIDIA equivalent)
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires an Apple processor
  • OS: High Sierra 10.13+
  • Processor: Apple M1 or Intel Core M
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Open GL 3.3 Support
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
